name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom renovation typically offers a good return on investment, especially in the Bay Area's competitive housing market. While ROI varies, a mid-range bathroom remodel can often recoup 60-70% of its cost upon resale. High-end renovations might see a slightly lower percentage but can significantly increase a home's appeal and market value. The actual ROI depends on the quality of work, design choices, and overall market conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovations generally offer a good ROI, with mid-range remodels recouping 60-70% of costs, enhancing home appeal and market value.
